subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should local hook installation intentionally reject a symlinked `HOOK.md` when adopting the bounded fs-safe reader?
rationale: The OOM mitigation is sound, but the selected helper also changes one previously accepted local filesystem shape; security-versus-compatibility intent cannot be inferred from the size-limit request alone.

options.title: Require regular-file metadata
options.body: Keep the shared helper and add focused coverage documenting that symlinked `HOOK.md` files are unsupported.

options.title: Preserve symlink support
options.body: Use a bounded reader that retains current symlink behavior while enforcing the byte limit.

recommendation.title: Require regular-file metadata
recommendation.body: Keep the shared helper and add focused coverage documenting that symlinked `HOOK.md` files are unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined provenance for hook installation security and the pinned fs-safe contract.
